localChanges: Trigger changed from `$skill-name` to OMP-style mid-prompt `/skill:name`: parser.ts token scan and getSkillCompletionPrefix rewritten; tokens must start a word so paths like docs/skill:x don't match
index.ts: autocomplete only takes over for a `/` with text before it, offers prefix matches, and inserts `/skill:name ` in place; a leading `/` keeps Pi's command menu
index.ts: skip expansion when the prompt starts with '/', so Pi's native /skill: and other commands still run
index.ts trimmed: removed Loaded-skills notify, Skills widget, /skills and /skills-search commands
resolver.ts: removed formatSkillTable (only used by the removed /skills command)
Menu opening on a mid-line `/` lives in ../input-bar.ts (InputBarEditor.handleInput), since Pi's editor only auto-opens on a leading `/`
